data.comment: Base URL of the AEM persisted-query endpoint, WITHOUT trailing slash, e.g. https://publish-pXXXX-eYYYY.adobeaemcloud.com/graphql/execute.json. Leave empty to use the same-origin relative path /graphql/execute.json (works when the endpoint is proxied on this domain).
AEM project/config name that persisted queries are published under, i.e. the {project} segment in /graphql/execute.json/{project}/{queryName}.
Name of the persisted GraphQL query that returns one hero fragment for a given path parameter. Called as /graphql/execute.json/{project}/{queryName};path={cfPath}.

LOCAL DEV ONLY. Optional Authorization header sent with CF GraphQL requests, for a protected AEM author instance. 'Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=' is base64 of the default admin:admin credential. REMOVE (set to empty) for production — requests should target an unauthenticated publish tier, and this default credential must never reach a deployed site.
